[1] faq.md > Do you ship fuel to Canada?
### Do you ship fuel to Canada?

No. Clearburn white gas, lamp oil and kerosene ship by ground only inside the United States, and
never to Canada, Alaska, Hawaii or a PO box. If a Canadian order contains fuel, we remove the fuel
and refund it before the rest of the order ships.

[2] customer-service-playbook.md > FUEL-01 Fuel shipping limits
### FUEL-01 Fuel shipping limits

Hello {name}, Clearburn white gas, lamp oil and kerosene can only ship by ground within the lower
48 states, and not to a PO box, to Alaska, to Hawaii or to Canada. I am sorry we cannot send the
fuel in order {order} to that address. Both of our showrooms stock fuel for pickup, and the rest of
your order can ship as usual if you would like me to remove the fuel from it.

[3] shipping.md > Fuel and hazardous materials
## Fuel and hazardous materials

Clearburn White Gas (LS-FUEL1), Clearburn Lamp Oil (LS-OIL1) and kerosene are limited-quantity
hazardous materials, shipped as ORM-D. The rules are:

- Fuel ships by ground only. It cannot go expedited or overnight; an order containing fuel is
  downgraded to standard shipping and the customer is told at checkout.
- Fuel does not ship to PO boxes.
- Fuel does not ship to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada.
- No more than 8 quarts of fuel ship in one package. Larger fuel orders are split.
- Fuel ships only in its original sealed container, in the warehouse's partitioned fuel cartons.

An order that mixes fuel with other items ships as two packages when the non-fuel items are
eligible for a faster service the customer has paid for. Otherwise the whole order ships ground.

Fuel-burning lanterns that have never had fuel in them are ordinary goods and ship by any
service. A fueled lantern, for example one coming back for repair, must be fully drained and
aired out before it ships; the Repair Center's instructions cover this.

[5] fuel-safety.md > Shipping fuel
## Shipping fuel

Fuel ships by ground only, as a limited-quantity hazardous material (ORM-D), from the
Hagerstown warehouse. It cannot ship expedited or overnight, cannot be delivered to a PO box,
and cannot be shipped to Alaska, Hawaii or Canada. An order that contains fuel ships as a whole
by ground; if you want the rest of your order faster, place the fuel on its own order. Fuel is
final sale once opened and cannot be returned by mail at all, opened or not; an unopened can
bought in error can be returned to either showroom for a refund.

Never ship a lantern with fuel in it, including for a warranty or repair return. Drain it,
let it air for a day, and pack it with the cap off. A lantern that arrives at Dock B with fuel
in it is drained before it is looked at, and we charge nothing for that, but the carrier can
refuse the box and the law is on their side.
